title: Missing Input Validation and Size Limits on Username in Awareness State
details: Resolved. The collaborator username input has been secured with `maxLength={50}`, and the awareness payload is truncated using `.slice(0, 50).trim() || 'Anonymous'` before broadcast.

title: WebSocket Server Prototype Pollution Crash (DoS)
details: Resolved. The registry `AUTHORIZED_ACCESS` was updated to inherit from `null` (`Object.create(null)`), and lookups are guarded using `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(AUTHORIZED_ACCESS, boardId)`. The server also ensures both `boardId` and `token` parameters are strings.

title: WebSocket URL Parameter Injection
details: Resolved. The client now properly encodes the user inputs when building the WebSocket connection string using `encodeURIComponent()`.

title: Destructive Overwrite of Nested Y.Arrays
details: Resolved. The developer replaced nested Y.Arrays under the 'columns' map with static top-level Y.Arrays using `doc.getArray('col-' + columnId)`.

title: Orphaned Card References in Column Arrays
details: Resolved. Check-then-act validation ensures card maps exist before modification, and orphaned references are pruned at render time.

title: Redundant Position State and Conflict Storms
details: Resolved. The redundant `position` map field was removed, with card positions derived dynamically from array indexes.

title: Missing Input Validation and Size Limits
details: Resolved. Input validation rules, trimming, and maxLength constraints have been enforced.
